roles.source_excerpt: Linda E. McMahon serves as the 13th United States Secretary of Education

summary.text: As Secretary of Education, Linda E. McMahon has promoted responsible AI use in classrooms and expanded AI learning opportunities for students. She praised Florida’s new AI rules as an example of states advancing responsible classroom AI and cited school visits where AI was integrated responsibly. McMahon described AI as having potential to personalize learning and prepare students for the workforce, while saying its use should be guided by fundamentals such as critical thinking and open debate. She also highlighted Education Department guidance on responsible AI in schools and encouraged participation in the Presidential AI Challenge and a task force on AI and education.
